name: video-style-distillation
description: 视频风格蒸馏专家：拆解某位自媒体博主的视频风格，蒸馏成可复用的风格档案，再据此生成同款风格的新视频。适用于模仿某博主做视频、学某达人的镜头/剪辑/口播风格等场景。支持抖音素材分析、风格七维拆解、风格档案产出、分镜脚本与视频生成。

interface.shortDescription: 拆解自媒体博主的视频风格，蒸馏成可复用的风格档案，再据此生成同款风格的新视频。
interface.longDescription: Video Style Distillation: Analyze a content creator's video style, distill it into a reusable style profile, then generate new videos in the same style. Supports Douyin material analysis, 7-dimension style breakdown (visual genes, narrative structure, audio, subtitles, content formula, rhythm, personality), style profile output, storyboard scripting, and AI video generation via built-in GenerateVideo or prompt-only mode.
defaultPrompt: Use video-style-distillation to analyze a creator's video style and generate similar videos.
